Elyx dependencies

Declare dependencies on other plugins and on Python packages.

Plugin dependencies

Use requires for named plugins and optional minimum versions. BYgram validates the dependency graph and enables dependencies before the consumer. A missing dependency may expose a URL for the user to open and confirm separately.

Python packages

Pure-Python wheels are resolved and bundled during conversion, with package-local imports. Binary third-party wheels inside plugin archives are rejected. The client bundles libraries including requests, Pillow, lxml and PyYAML.
